integratedBehavior: Portable schemas and generated Python/TypeScript runtimes enforce immutable event, project, trace, actor, activity, entity, relation, revision, configuration, sensitivity, and retention facts; lifecycle outcome and relation roles cannot contradict the recorded result.

SQLite schema v7 preserves exact migration history, append-only narrow audit and normalized ledger records, deterministic v1/v2 checkpoint segments, stable entity kinds, and transaction-bound outbox authority without reinterpreting historical v1 facts.

Canonical output cannot commit without exact actor-bound provenance and outbox facts; late failures roll the transaction back, exact retry converges after restart, changed commands and incompatible authority fail closed, and projection corruption enters integrity-review.

The authenticated Core lineage API returns bounded ancestors, descendants, production activity, responsible agent, rights/export disposition, integrity state, missing revision identities, and legacy count using a strict cursor that must advance or terminate.

The generated client rejects malformed or contradictory pages and builds export only from the complete query-bound page set. Integrity and rights authority can only become more restrictive across pagination; missing or legacy facts always deny complete verified export.

The desktop preserves the approved Audit and Lineage regions, exposes factual wasDerivedFrom paths and responsible activity/agent facts, distinguishes missing/legacy/integrity/rights states, and exports only a complete verified manifest.
